name: Jorge Eduardo Fernandez Torres
headline: Chief Financial Officer, Country Manager, Financial Controller, Finance Director
about:
Bilingual executive (20+ years reporting directly to U.S. Corporate HQ) with more than 15 years of experience as a controller; leading financial planning, and tax & accounting teams in several industries such as retail, manufacturing, distribution and services in Mexico and LATAM. 
Well-grounded in U.S. and Mexican financial reporting systems, IFRS, GAAP and Mexican Tax Laws, with a strong orientation to financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting.
… more

experiences.description:
Riso offers exclusive printing solutions in the fields of digital duplicating and inkjet printing, aiming to provide customers with the optimal product creation.
Controller
Responsible for safeguarding Company assets; supporting strategic plans to meet Corporate and Divisional objectives; reporting regional results in a timely and accurate fashion; ensuring compliance with local and international accounting principles and supporting Latin America and Brazil regions with above referenced responsibilities, budget and forecast preparation, reporting to the President in Miami.
Accomplishments:
• Obtained clean opinion from KPMG USGAAP external audit of Company consolidation package.
• Collaborated with the implementation of Netsuite Planning and Budgeting System platform.

Forever21 is an American fast fashion retailer headquartered in Los Angeles, California. The Company sells accessories, beauty products, home goods and clothing for women, men and children.

Responsible for the Company´s direction, safeguarding of Company assets and overseeing statutory compliance matters related to corporate office, distribution center and retail operations countrywide; as well as it´s legal representation before Government Authorities for more than five years. Managing a team of 10 department managers and reporting directly to Legal VP, Finance VP, Tax VP, and Operations VP in Los Angeles.

As a General Manager I worked closely with executives and key business group leaders to support decisions and evaluate potential business opportunities. I was also responsible for ensuring that all departments were completely aligned with Corporate US policies and acted as a liaison for those departments.

Responsible for safeguarding Company assets, overseeing the accounting, accounts payable, and payroll departments. Responsible for the preparation of financial statements for local regulatory requirements and Forever 21 Corporate Headquarter reporting requirements. Responsible for establishing internal controls specific to the Forever 21 group of Companies in Mexico, as well as ensuring adherence to the policies, practices and procedures of Forever 21, Inc. Legal representation of the Company before Government agencies and third parties.

Responsible for safeguarding Company assets; supporting strategic plans to meet Corporate and Divisional objectives; reporting regional results on a timely and accurate fashion; ensuring compliance with local and international financial reporting standards, and supporting Latin America and Brazil regions with the above referenced responsibilities.

- Provide support in any needed way to achieve Corporate, Divisional and Subsidiary objectives. - Accurate and timely financial reports, budgets and forecasts. - Expense control management. - Determination of Subsidiary standard costs. - Ensure optimal use of assets: accounts receivable, inventory and fixed assets. - Accurate and timely supervision of tax returns filing. - Customer service: accurate and timely delivery of products to customers, billing and collecting. - Handling of all legal and HR issues. - Daily operation of the Subsidiary and related matters.

Responsible for all financial and tax aspects of the Mexican operations including financial reporting to the Home Office, cash management, banking relationships, accounts receivable, accounts payable, treasury, H.R. and I.T aspects, and monthly and annual tax returns filing.
Responsibilities:
- Preparation of monthly financial statements under MEXGAAP for the Home Office in Winston-Salem, N.C. Monthly trips to the Home Office to perform month end closing activities and report them to regional controller. Development of internal accounting procedures and policies.

Responsible for reviewing, controlling and reporting all transactions in UCB de Mexico, including the preparation of Group and local official requirements and tax returns.
Responsibilities:
- Management of accounting department daily activities (organization, supervision of transaction recording, control, information system configuration, etc.). - Optimization of accounting layout in line with business, tax and legal requirements. - Definition, implementation and control of optimal fiscal policy (income tax and VAT) in line with the Group requirements and guidelines. - Report adequate periodic financial information to local departments and HQ (Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet) in line with timing and quality standards. - Control of fixed assets, accounts receivable (in collaboration with logistics) and payable. - Relation with corporate auditors and officials, including the preparation of official documents, formularies and reports. - Permanent improvement of internal accounting procedures and policies.

Responsible for all financial and tax aspects of the project including financial reporting, cash management, bank relationships, budgeting, risk management, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and monthly and annual tax returns filing.
Responsibilities:
- Preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements under MEXGAAP and USGAAP for lenders.- Preparation and filing of monthly income tax, value added tax, and withholding income tax returns before Mexican IRS.- Calculation of long term debt interest due to EXIM and IDB.- Computation of subordinated debt interest due to InterGen Denmark Finance, ApS.- Amortization of deferred debt issuance costs.- Utilization of interest rate swaps to hedge the Company’s interest rate risk. - Determination of monthly cost using the average cost method. -Invoicing and collection processes implementation.- Capitalization of construction in progress under SOP 98-5 provisions.- Filing of monthly value added tax reimbursement requests before Mexican IRS.- Fixed assets control and monthly depreciation computation.- Supervision and coordination of accounts payable activities.- Supervision and coordination of treasury activities. - Monthly closing processes, including among others, monetary accounts valuation, restatement processes and restated balances computation.  - Participation in weekly conference calls to discuss the Project’s progress.- Preparation of monthly disbursement requests.- Monthly variances analysis and comparison of budgeted figures vs. actuals.- Monthly accruals determination. - Monthly accounts reconciliation. - External audit process (PWC and D&T) to ensure compliance with Group and local requirements.

- Import / Export control. - Intercompany due to / due from accounts reconciliation between Mexico and a number of affiliates.- Monthly intercompany closing.- Fixed assets control and monthly depreciation computation of over 15,000 assets.- Asset additions, transfers and disposals.- Determination of cumulative translation adjustments of the fixed assets accounts for USGAAP purposes.- Monthly fixed assets closing.- Monthly cost of sales determination.- Monthly inventory valuation at average cost of more than 1,200 raw materials and finished goods.- Determination of the LIFO value of the inventories.-Monthly inventory and cost accounting closing.

experiences.position: Accounting and Tax Analyst / Tax Advisor
experiences.description: - Preparation and filing of monthly and annual tax returns.- Calculation of inflationary effects for tax purposes.- Fixed assets control.- Monthly tax accrual determination.- Monthly accounts reconciliation.- Tax advisory in general for the following companies: Arrow Hart, Cooper Automotive, Comerica Bank, Ingram Micro, Max Music, Rich Products, Texas Instruments, Unisys, Warner Music, and Wal Mart.
